company.name: Magicflow
company.shortDescription: Magicflow is a no-code, drag-and-drop tool for building AI workflows.
company.description: Magicflow operates as a no-code platform that enables the creation of AI workflows. It provides a drag-and-drop tool that simplifies the process of building and integrating AI workflows into applications. The platform is designed to handle complex workflows, making it a valuable tool for developers. Additionally, Magicflow offers a productivity tracker that helps users optimize their productivity by generating insights from screentime. It is also used as a deep work tracker for builders and makers, assisting them in achieving peak performance.
